pages.title: Food with a Twist
pages.text: Eat an Everlasting Flame Steak and retain it after consumption.

pages.title: Food with a Twist
pages.text: Distinguish special foods' native utility from ordinary hunger restoration.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: This food has its own consumption rule. Soul Return Rice relates to a death location, while star and fiery meals have other effects; choose using their native tooltips.

pages.title: Return with Soul Return Rice
pages.text: Soul Return Rice uses a recorded death location, not your bed. Do not provoke a death for this lesson; event teleport restrictions still apply.

pages.title: Use special Nether meals
pages.text: Everlasting Flame Steak remains after eating. Star Stew and fiery dishes have different active abilities; understand the tooltip before using explosive food near buildings.

pages.title: Choose a Nether food buff
pages.text: Warped and Crimson dishes, Ghost and Glowing effects, Lava Walker and Blazing properties serve different purposes. Magma-block protection does not imply lava-fluid immunity, and friendly magma cubes can still burn.
